name: Interior designer

google_prefill.phone: [G] the listed phone (stays the business's; customers use Rosie's one number)

A.flow: A: the customer comes to the business (video or phone count as A)

services.name: Sample review
services.story: Sample review, $35 at the studio on a Saturday morning; a card saved for the $20 missed-review fee; charged to the saved card when Mira texts DONE.

services.name: Sample review
services.story: The same sample review on a weekday: a card saved for the $20 fee; paid at the studio desk (a full-room studio session, $140, saves a card for its $40 fee the same way).

services.name: Video design consultation
services.story: Video design consultation, $150, paid in full when booking (e-design, $600, is paid the same way).

services.name: Window treatment design
services.story: Window treatment design priced from Alex's photos at $90, OK'd by Sam; a card saved; paid at the studio desk.

services.name: Custom furniture design
services.story: Custom furniture design, from $110, priced at the studio after a $25 consult; a card saved; paid at the desk.

B.flow: B: the business goes to the customer

services.name: In-home design consultation
services.story: Living room and kitchen design: the $175 in-home consultation, a card saved for the late-cancel fee; Nadia's written proposal; the agreement, a $2,400 retainer, a $1,200 change order; the last $3,600 on the bill Rosie texts.

services.name: In-home design consultation
services.story: The same project, but Sam bills the retainer and the last payment the business's own way; Rosie sends nothing about money.

services.name: Color consultation
services.story: Color consultation at home, $179 from the list; a card saved; Rosie texts the bill after (the lighting plan, $199, works the same way).

services.name: Furniture layout plan
services.story: Furniture layout plan, $150, paid in full when booking (and the studio's $75 sample review at home).

services.name: Room refresh
services.story: A guest room refresh priced from photos at $640 (over $500, so Sam OKs it); a signed agreement; a 25% deposit of $160; the rest on the bill.

services.name: In-home design consultation
services.story: The same project, but the saved card is charged at DONE, as the old example charged its consultation: only the $175 if Alex doesn't sign, or the last $3,600 at the walk-through.

questions_before_times: Which rooms, and what would you like to change?
A home, or a business space like an office or a shop?
Roughly how big are the rooms?
When would you like it done?
safety_stop: a gas smell, sparking or smoking wires, a carbon monoxide alarm
a ceiling sagging, or a wall cracking and moving
license: if: most states license no interior design for homes. Some protect the title 'registered interior designer', and a few require a registered or licensed designer for business spaces (offices, shops). All of it comes from the state's form.
